lessons.title: Question: Percent of a container
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set the width of a button nested inside a <div> element using percentages?

The percentage is related to div elementThe percentage is related to the bodyThe percentage is related to the button element

The percentage is related to div element.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A <div> is 400px wide. Its nested button has width: 25%;. How wide is the button?

100px, one quarter of the <div>25px, because the percentage becomes pixelsOne quarter of the <body> width

100px, one quarter of the <div>.

240px100px300px

class="red blue".

.blue.redp

lessons.interactiveContent:
Why do we add multiple CSS classes to elements?

To combine multiple stylesTo create more classes that do the same thingTo separate the HTML and the CSS

To combine multiple styles.

The warning class makes text red, and large increases its size. Which value gives one element both styles?

class="warning large"class="warning"class="warning.large"

Make sure to pick class="warning large".

lessons.title: Question: Grouping selector

What separator is used to group multiple selectors?

A commaAn underscoreSingle quotes

A comma.
lessons.hardModeContent:
The separator used to group multiple selectors is a comma, so those selectors can share one CSS rule.

You want one rule to style every <h1> and every element with class title. Which selector starts the grouped rule?

h1, .title {h1 .title {h1 + .title {

Make sure to pick h1, .title {.
